new_task_1.title: Expose HTTP response protocol version strings
new_task_1.description: HTTP response objects now carry a protocol version string alongside the existing numeric version, with concrete response implementations populating it for HTTP/1.x, HTTP/2, and unknown Emscripten responses. Connection pool debug logging is also based on response version data rather than a private connection version string.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Make the protocol version associated with a response available on the response object itself and avoid relying on private connection state when logging response versions.

expectation.grounded: BaseHTTPResponse must store a required version_string value. HTTPResponse must accept an optional version_string argument defaulting to "HTTP/?" and pass it to BaseHTTPResponse. HTTPConnection must populate version_string from its _http_vsn_str value when available, HTTP2Response must use "HTTP/2", and the Emscripten response wrapper must use "HTTP/?". HTTPConnectionPool debug logging must use response version data instead of reading _http_vsn_str from the connection.
expectation.conceptual: Callers and library internals should be able to inspect or log the protocol version from the response object, including transports that do not expose CPython HTTPConnection private attributes.

constraints.grounded: Do not change the existing numeric response.version values, status handling, reason handling, response body behavior, or header handling. Preserve the default unknown protocol marker for responses that cannot provide a concrete HTTP version string.
constraints.conceptual: The change should add response metadata and make logging less dependent on connection internals without altering response semantics.

behavior: BaseHTTPResponse instances expose a version_string attribute initialized from constructor input.
HTTPResponse callers can provide version_string explicitly, while omitted values default to "HTTP/?".
HTTP/1.x responses created from HTTPConnection carry the connection's HTTP version string when that value is available.
HTTP/2 responses carry "HTTP/2" as their protocol version string.
Emscripten responses carry "HTTP/?" as an unknown protocol version string.
Connection pool debug logging derives the logged HTTP version from response version data instead of connection._http_vsn_str.
acceptance_criteria: When BaseHTTPResponse is constructed with a version_string, the resulting response exposes that same value as response.version_string.
When HTTPResponse is constructed without version_string, response.version_string is "HTTP/?".
When HTTPResponse is constructed with an explicit version_string such as "HTTP/1.1", response.version_string preserves that string.
When HTTPConnection builds a response from an httplib response, the response includes the connection HTTP version string when _http_vsn_str is present and falls back to "HTTP/?" otherwise.
When an HTTP2Response is created, response.version remains 20 and response.version_string is "HTTP/2".
When an EmscriptenHttpResponseWrapper is created, response.version remains 0 and response.version_string is "HTTP/?".
When HTTPConnectionPool emits its debug request/response log line, it should not read _http_vsn_str directly from the connection object.
